mapper.sql: id, username, password_hash, nickname, is_enabled, must_change_password, auth_version, time_zone, pending_time_zone, time_zone_effective_at, version, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM identity_user WHERE lower(username COLLATE "C") = lower(#{username} COLLATE "C")
SELECT FROM identity_user WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql:
WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (u.username ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.nickname ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND u.is_enabled = #{enabled}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_user_role ur JOIN identity_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.code = #{role})
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_user_role ur JOIN identity_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.code IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM identity_user u ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_user_role ur JOIN identity_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.code IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'))) AS users,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_user_role ur JOIN identity_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.code IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN')))) AS administrators,
count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT u.is_enabled) AS disabled, count(*) FILTER (WHERE u.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS deleted FROM identity_user u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_user_role ur JOIN identity_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.code IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity_user (username, password_hash, nickname, time_zone, must_change_password, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{timeZone}, #{mustChangePassword}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE identity_user SET time_zone = #{timeZone}, pending_time_zone = #{pendingTimeZone}, time_zone_effective_at = #{timeZoneEffectiveAt}, version = version + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE identity_user SET auth_version=auth_version+1,version=version+1,updated_at=now(),updated_by=#{actorId} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
